We moved here a number of years ago as our previous surgery was horrific and also lost our medical records.

We moved here although it’s a little bit further to travel. I ring up at 0800hrs and always manage to get an appointment for the same day. I get referred immediately for any complaints or bloods required.

Recently my 7 year old daughter was sent home from school for a UTI. I rang around midday and she was seen at 330pm the same day.
